_comment: Microsoft Graph permission IDs required by the demo. Reference for the operator running the `az ad app create` steps in quickstart §1.3.

application.description: Per-site write access for Case 1 (SharePoint draft upload). Must be granted with a site-scoped write permission on the target site (Graph API: POST /sites/{site-id}/permissions).

delegated.description: Operator's OneDrive write access for Case 2.
Send notification mail from operator's mailbox.
Allow refresh token for OBO flow.
